  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_entity","line":221,"var":"codepoint","code":"for(i = 3; i < size-1; i++) codepoint = 16 * codepoint + hex_val(text[i]);","note":"A long hexadecimal entity drives repeated arithmetic on attacker-controlled bytes and can overflow the unsigned accumulator."},

  {"step":12,"file":"src-vul/md4c/test/fuzzers/fuzz-mdhtml.c","function":"process_output","line":7,"var":"out","code":"return;","note":"The harness ignores output, so the crash must happen in parsing or rendering of the attacker-controlled image data."}
